clauses.title: Scope – Requirements and
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements and the methods of sampling and test for expanded polystyrene in the form of rough shapes, finished boards and blocks, and pipe sections / segments for thermal insulation primarily for use in refrigeration and building applications in the temperature range - 150º to 80ºC.

clauses.title: Types
clauses.text: 2. Types Type 1- Non-self extinguishing type and, Type 2- Self extinguishing type

clauses.title: Bulk Density – The
clauses.text: 3.1 Bulk Density - The bulk density of the material, calculated at nominal thickness, excluding facing, shall be 15, 20, 25, 30 or 35 kg/m3. A tolerance of ±5 percent shall be allowed on bulk density.

clauses.title: Size – 1.0 x
clauses.text: 3.2.1 Size - 1.0 x 0.5 m or other agreed sizes. Pipe sections / segments — 1.0 m or 0.5 m in length, or other agreed length.

clauses.title: Thickness – 15, 20,
clauses.text: 3.2.2  Thickness -  15, 20, 25, 40, 50, 60, 75 and 100 mm unless otherwise agreed.

clauses.title: Tolerance
clauses.text: 3.2.3  Tolerance Finished Boards and Blocks Tolerance Length, width and thickness ± 2 mm Pipe Laggings Outside diameter ± 3 mm Inside diameter ± 2 mm

clauses.title: Thermal Conductivity – Shall
clauses.text: 3.3 Thermal Conductivity - Shall not exceed the values given below: Bulk Density Thermal Conductivity kg/m3 mW/cm0C 0ºC 10ºC 15.0 0.34 0.37 20.0 0.32 0.35 25.0 0.30 0.33 30.0 0.29 0.32 35.0 0.28 0.31 Note - To convert values from mW/cm deg to kcal/m h deg or vice versa, the following conversion factors are used : Kilocolories / m h ºC Milliwalts / cm ºC 1 11.630 0 0.085 985 1

clauses.title: The material of both
clauses.text: 3.4 The material of both the types shall also comply with the requirements given in Table 1.

clauses.title: Flammability – The material
clauses.text: 3.5.1 Flammability - The material shall be of self extinguishing type when tested by the method prescribed in Appendix F of the standard.
